businesses.business: Hormone therapy practice support and products

offering_description.value: Biote supplies hormone pellets and procedure kits and helps independent healthcare practices offer hormone therapy. It manufactures compounded pellets and provides clinician training, clinical software and practice support. It also sells dietary supplements through healthcare practices and online.

primary_products.value: compounded hormone pellets; pellet insertion kits; dietary supplements

primary_services.value: clinician training in hormone therapy; practice development and operational support; clinical decision support

customer_segment.value: B2B: independent medical practices and licensed healthcare practitioners offering hormone therapy; B2C: consumers who purchase dietary supplements

end_markets.value: outpatient healthcare; hormone therapy; consumer dietary supplements

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees paid by practices for each pellet therapy procedure under the program; product sales: hormone pellets, insertion supplies and dietary supplements
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: turns clinical protocols into training and practice support for independent healthcare providers; OEM / manufacturer: compounds hormone ingredients into pellets for healthcare practices; software / platform: uses patient and lab data to support clinicians’ treatment decisions; brand owner: markets dietary supplements made by contract manufacturers to practices and consumers
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; brand owner

geography_served.value: US national: healthcare practices and supplement customers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: hormone therapy practice support, compounded pellets, procedure kits and dietary supplements

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales representatives who enroll and support independent healthcare practices; partners / resellers: participating healthcare practices that offer supplements to patients; online: company online store for dietary supplements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: hormone pellet compounding under federal FDA oversight and applicable state pharmacy rules
